turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Of course. Could you send me your order number and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll check whether the print is eligible for return.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.
I’ve filed your return request for order SC-5211 (reference R-1). You’ll need to cover the return postage, and the refund is pending staff approval.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

turns.text: I will pay the return postage. Please file the return for the team to approve. I am not asking for a reprint.
Your return request for order SC-5211 is already filed under reference R-1 and is awaiting staff approval. No reprint was requested.
